tagline: Channel history and search for remote teammates — messages sent as you need your approval.
requirements: Create a Discord bot, enable the Message Content intent, invite it to the server, and set DISCORD_TOKEN in the host environment (GUILD_ID scopes it to one server). Discord has no official MCP server, so this entry uses a maintained community server. Prefer a bot that can only read the channels you intend to share.

tools.name: discord_get_message_history
tools.note: Reads channel history — message contents flow to the guest.

tools.name: discord_send_message
tools.note: Posts messages as the bot — or as you, with a user token.

tools.name: discord_get_dm_channels
tools.note: Lists DMs — private conversations, only allow for a dedicated bot account.

tools.name: discord_get_friends
tools.note: Lists the account's friends — personal data, only for a dedicated bot account.

tools.name: discord_download_attachment
tools.note: Downloads attachment files onto the host disk.

seo.description: Share Discord MCP tools with MCPWire. Configure a scoped bot token on the host, let teammates read channel history over P2P, and keep sending and account changes behind approval.
